_comment: Image -> textured 3D MESH with Hunyuan3D 2.1. Outputs a .glb you can drop straight into Unity, Unreal or Blender. This is the modality the box could not do at all until 2026-07-29.
_notes: The whole pipeline is driven by CLIP-VISION, not text. There is no prompt anywhere in this graph - the input image IS the prompt. Composition of that image therefore decides everything: a single object, centred, fully visible, plain background, even frontal light, no cast shadow. Crop a subject out of a busy scene first (workflow 13 or 14) rather than feeding the scene.
`ImageOnlyCheckpointLoader` returns MODEL, CLIP_VISION, VAE from the one 6.9 GB file. There is no text encoder to load - that is why this is the cheapest new modality on the box.
resolution 4096 on EmptyLatentHunyuan3Dv2 is the LATENT token count, not pixels. Raising it buys geometric detail and costs VRAM roughly linearly. 3072 is the node default; the template uses 4096.

octree_resolution 256 on VAEDecodeHunyuan3D is the voxel grid the mesh is extracted from - this is the real 'mesh detail' dial. 256 is a good balance; 384 gets noticeably finer at a big memory cost. num_chunks 8000 only affects decode batching, not quality.

VoxelToMesh threshold 0.6 is the iso-surface level. Lower it (~0.45) if the mesh comes out with holes or missing thin parts; raise it (~0.7) if it comes out bloated and blobby. `surface net` is smoother than `basic` and is what you want.
cfg 5.0 and 30 steps are the template values and matter more here than in image work - this model has no distilled/turbo variant, so there is no 4-step shortcut.

MEASURED OUTPUT: 187,314 vertices / 525,708 triangles / 8.5 MB in 19.5 s. Inspecting the glTF, the mesh carries a POSITION attribute and NOTHING ELSE - no COLOR_0, no NORMAL, no TEXCOORD. So it is raw geometry: no vertex colour, no normals, no UVs, no texture. Plan on Blender for shade-smooth, decimate, unwrap and bake. Usable as-is for previz, greyboxing, silhouette work, 3D printing and distant props; not usable as a finished game asset. If you want colour out of the box, use workflow 25 - a splat carries its own.
Half a million triangles from a 1024px input is dense to the point of being unwieldy. Decimate to 5-10% in Blender before doing anything with it.
For a Gaussian-splat result instead of a mesh, see workflow 25. Splats look better; meshes are what a game engine can actually use.
